tutorials.title: Tutorials

understandInvites.title: Understand invites
understandInvites.description: Pick a class and a student who cancels, and see exactly who would be invited and why.
understandInvites.intro: This is a rehearsal: nothing is sent, nobody is placed, no spot is opened.
understandInvites.stepResults: 3. What the engine would do right now
understandInvites.noClasses: You have no classes with enrolled students in the next 4 weeks.
understandInvites.noPlayers: This class has no enrolled students.
understandInvites.error: Could not simulate. Please try again.
understandInvites.blockedTitle: Right now the engine would contact nobody
understandInvites.clearTitle: Nothing stops a send right now
understandInvites.approvalRequired: You are in semi-automatic mode: before anything is sent, you would be asked to approve this list.
understandInvites.waitingList: {{name}} would be placed directly from the waiting list — nobody is invited for this spot.

gates.auto_notify_disabled: The automatic invitation engine is switched off.
gates.class_notifications_disabled: Notifications are switched off for this class.
gates.class_over: The class has already started or finished.
gates.min_time_before_class: Less than {{minutes}} minutes remain before the class.
gates.max_total_reached: {{sent}} invitations were already sent for this class (limit {{limit}}).

gatesOk.class_notifications_disabled: Notifications are on for this class

gatesOk.min_time_before_class: There is still time before the class

stages.departing_player: This is the student who cancels — the spot is theirs.
stages.already_invited: Already has a pending invitation for this spot.
stages.eligibility: Below the eligibility bar for this class:
stages.excluded_by_coach: You excluded this student from automatic invitations (Settings › Notifications › Restrictions).
stages.inactive_account: The account is not active and inactive accounts are excluded.
stages.unavailable: Marked themselves unavailable at this class's time.

level.equal_or_above_class: level equal to or above the class
level.equal_or_below_class: level equal to or below the class

eligibility.classHasNoLevel: the class has no level, so no level rule can be met
eligibility.studentHasNoLevel: the student has no level assigned
eligibility.levelNotInLadder: the student's level is not in your level ladder
eligibility.absencesOver: over the unjustified-absence limit ({{actual}}, limit is {{threshold}})
eligibility.justifiedAbsences: justified absences outside the limit ({{actual}}, limit is {{threshold}})
eligibility.attendanceUnder: attendance outside the limit ({{actual}}%, limit is {{threshold}}%)

levelSource.player: level taken from the student who cancels
levelSource.class: level taken from the class (the student has none)
